texts.name: Ergon
texts.biography: After taking the throne of Krewlod, Kilgor brought Ergon to quell the rebellion of the Ogres who were still loyal to Winston Boragus, even after his death. Needless to say, the veteran of Succession Wars did his job very effectively by raiding the unruly tribes with his exotic beasts.

specialty.name: Brass Couatls
specialty.description: Increases the Speed of any Brass Couatls or Quetzalcouatls by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 7 levels (rounded up).

texts.name: Tartarr
texts.biography: Born into a poor Ogre family, Tartarr always dreamed of glorious conquests. Leaving home at fourteen to become a mercenary, her fierce stubbornness and innate defensive magic helped her survive the unforgiving wilds of Krulaw. It was this unbreakable resilience that earned her the respect of the continent's most fearsome apex predators. Now, when Tartarr marches to war, massive Behemoths willingly follow her lead.

specialty.name: Behemoths
specialty.description: Increases the Speed of any Behemoths or Ancient Behemoths by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 7 levels (rounded up).
